patch_description: Following the recommendation, we deepen the existing ansatz by stacking a second copy of the RY–CZ–CRZ block immediately after the first one, while reusing exactly the same parameter names (ry_01, ry_23, ry_45, ry_67, crz_shared) for the duplicated gates. Because parameter names are shared within a single ansatz-block execution, this does not add any new trainable parameters (the unique parameter count stays at 5), but it doubles the effective circuit depth and gate count within one block application. This tests whether additional expressivity/depth—achieved purely through gate repetition rather than new parameters—can improve convergence speed (fewer training steps) and/or accuracy generalization without paying any parameter-economy penalty, addressing the current program's relatively high n_params (32) and mediocre score (0.65) versus the 14-param/0.72-score alternative that used far fewer unique parameters but much deeper structure.
